geometry: 14 by 14 icon with a translucent black background and a one-unit white square-wave stroke. The white waveform spans x=2 to 12 and y=2 to 12; its square-ended steps are centered at x=2.5, 5.5, 8.5 and 11.5.
limitations: The four source background corner pixels have slightly lower alpha; the SVG approximates them with a small corner radius.
